## Summary
Explain what this pull request changes and link to the Issue.

## Checklist
- [ ] One focused change with a clear definition of done
- [ ] Ran npm run check
- [ ] Tested UI in a browser if it changed
- [ ] No passwords, API tokens or actual private user data
- [ ] No claim of functioning server, realtime or live AI unless implemented and tested
- [ ] Correct separation of public documentation and private notes

## Screenshots or test evidence
Describe how to verify the change.
